title: Local splitting of epimorphisms onto finite free internal module sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme and R a commutative ring object in abelian sheaves on X_proet. For internal R-modules M,N and an epimorphism f:M→N with N finite free, there exists a pro-etale cover of X on every member of which the restricted f is a split epimorphism. No noetherianity or coefficient field assumption is required.

source.place: Section 6.8, local lifting of finitely many module generators

proof.text: Underlying abelian sheaf epimorphisms are locally surjective. The sheaf unit and the adjunction with sheafification convert a local section lift into a map from the regular module. The module action identity makes this correspondence compatible with the given module epimorphism.

Choose a finite free presentation of the target as a finite biproduct of regular modules. Apply the preceding local lift to all its basis maps on a common finite refinement. The biproduct of the resulting lifts, transported through the chosen free-module isomorphism and the pullback regular-module comparison, is a section. Its composite with the restricted f is the identity by the biproduct component equations. For rank zero the same equations require no basis lifts.
